snippet.title: Jumpbound - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Jumpbound is coming out September 24th 2025! In this challenging yet atmospheric first-person platformer, each milestone you reach unlocks a new jump or dash. What starts as a single leap quickly becomes a set of moves that lets you reach heights that once felt impossible.

Set on a mysterious and beautiful planet, Jumpbound combines meditative exploration with high-stakes platforming. Enjoy the view and relaxing atmosphere as you find your way up while subtle storytelling emerges through cryptic ruins and fragments of the protagonist’s inner thoughts. 

Inspired by the jumping puzzles of games like Destiny 2, DOOM Eternal, and Guild Wars 2 and the progressing mood and beauty of games like Journey, Jumpbound invites you to a proper challenge that ensures a relaxing experience even in the face of failure.

Do you think you can reach the top? Wishlist on Steam and you can find out on September 24th: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3448250/Jumpbound
